author: Santikpo98
body:
IGN: Santikpo98
Discord( Name#):Santikpo98#3779
Timezone: UTC -3 (I think so, im from Argentina)
Any previous Ref experience? I do not have experience as a referee nor playing tournaments here, but I play all the OvercastNetwork tournaments except two and unofficial tournaments, I have a lot of experience from inside a match and I plan to use it to help staff and users from outside and no longer as a player but as a referee. Why would you like to join the referee team: Because I like to help, and I want the rules of the server to be fulfilled and to be able to advise the players.
Are you able to commit to Saturday Tournaments, and occasionally event staff meetings? Yes i am.
A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself:
Anything else?:  I love playing tournaments, but I never had the chance to be referee and I would like to try it, thanks to my experience I think I will be good and I will be useful. My English is not the best, I speak Spanish and I understand Italian.

- The Officials
